title: Test remote permission and unqualified-mode rejection
description:
Scope: permission/profile constraint cases in the admission supplement under /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/test/vectors/. Independently specify permitted narrowing and forbidden expansion of local frequencies, power, antenna conditions, budgets and supported PHY modes. Include unknown plans, band edges, upper indices, missing capability and unqualified full-band/experimental profiles. Distinguish ordinary FHSS, DTS, hybrid and amateur basis requirements from the authority input matrix. Do not change station/grant policy, disable encryption, expand real regional tables or infer eligibility from radio tuning range.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Keep fixture inputs distinct from production permissions and measurement evidence. Test unknown prerequisites as explicit denials, not as skipped cases or assumed authority.
acceptance_criteria: Source-backed expected decisions reject every remote expansion and unknown/unqualified configuration while permitting only independently valid narrowing. Exact integer-Hz edges and configuration limits are checked; nominal bandwidth or a driver enum cannot substitute for required measured-bandwidth evidence. Candidate 128-channel and experimental modes remain disabled without their own qualification. No software case silently substitutes another operating basis or security policy. All required negatives are schema-valid and included for real TX-path execution.
